title: (No AI) Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
author: Emma Roth
content:
![An image showing Gemini’s Personal Intelligence feature on a car’s display](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/google-gemini-personal-intelligence.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Google is [bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-auto-cars-with-google-built-in-gemini-personal-intelligence/) in your car. With this update, Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search.

As an example, Google says you can ask Gemini about your flight status if you're driving to the airport. The AI assistant can pull your flight details from a confirmation message in Gmail and then use that information to look up the status. title: (No AI) Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
author: Emma Roth
content:
![The Muse AI mascot and logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/STKB394_MUSE_AI_CVIRGINIA_A.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, [as reported by _Ars Technica_](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/meta-muse-exposes-users-personal-and-business-secrets-when-they-share-conversations/?utm_source=bsky&utm_medium=social). In [a report published this week](https://blog.claroc.io/ghostshares-muse-passive-dns/#_), researchers at the security firm Claroc say they found more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records.

"People have the ability to share specific Muse artifacts, which creates a page that can be accessed by those with the link," Muse spokesperson Tracy Clayton says in an emailed statement to _The Verge_. "However, we've paused this functionality while we review this report and consider changes to how these links can be dis …
